headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of August 21, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.60% compared to SPY's 13.09%. This results in an average alpha of 11.52%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' shows a significant return of 46.52%, driven by strong performance from its top holding, PANW, which has returned 130.90%. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' has a return of 11.20%, highlighting a notable variance in performance across the portfolio set. Outperforming SPY during this period signals resilience and effective positioning amid broader market conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
